acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen backsplash installation in the Las Vegas area varies widely based on several factors. Material choice is a significant determinant; basic ceramic tiles are more affordable than intricate natural stone or custom glass. The complexity of the installation, including layout, cuts, and demolition of an existing backsplash, also impacts the price. Labor costs are factored in, which can fluctuate. For an accurate estimate tailored to your project, we recommend a consultation with Simply Construction, as we serve specific areas like Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, and Henderson.
